entities.name: RNF5 E3 ligase
observations: The 180-aa query matches reviewed RNF5 proteins across 100% query coverage (88.3–88.9% identity) and contains a predicted RING domain at residues 26–72.

Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 2.3.2.27 and describe transfer of ubiquitin from an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme to a target protein lysine; substrate examples are annotation-context dependent.
